verdicts.reason: Both make the same structural mistake. The beige brush-stroke panel is cut off from the title and left floating up in the jar area. The 'Spa Utopia' title runs over the left-edge dropper bottle, and the text sits low on a busy photo with no backing. In A, 'Weekly SPA items review' fits with some margin. In B, the larger subtitle runs into the green bottle at the right edge and leaves almost no right margin, so B is slightly worse.
